# Step 5 private finding: comment edit review

- The team notes disagree on the shape of a "not found" response. code-comment-ownership.md describes the existing delete path, which returns 404 with an empty body. policy-error-response.md says new error responses use the errors-object body. The comment edit change follows the policy because the policy governs new responses and the ownership note only describes current code. Keep this in mind if a later review sees the two notes used together.
- code-comment-model.md says there is no editedAt field. Once this change lands that note is stale and should be updated by whoever owns the notes, not by the reviewer.
- The release checklist step (run prisma migrate deploy on a fresh database) cannot be seen in a diff. Treat it as unverified in any review that only reads the diff.

content.text:
**Question 1:** A comment may be edited for 30 minutes after it was created. After that the API refuses the edit. Source: `policy-edit-window.md`. No other note disagrees.

**Review of the working-tree diff** (the diff is unstaged plus one new migration file; nothing is staged)

| Rule | Code value | Rule value | Source | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window | `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000`, refuses when `Date.now() - createdAt > window` (`article.service.ts`, updateComment) | 30 minutes after creation, then refused | `policy-edit-window.md` | PASS |
| Edited marker: nullable field | `editedAt DateTime?` (`schema.prisma`, Comment model) | Nullable timestamp, null until first edit | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | PASS |
| Edited marker: set on edit | `data: { body, editedAt: new Date() }` (`article.service.ts`) | Each successful edit sets it to the edit time | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | PASS |
| Edited marker: migration keeps rows | `ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD COLUMN "editedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);` with no UPDATE or default (`migration.sql`) | Must not change existing rows | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | PASS |
| Error response shape, 422 | `{ errors: { body: ["can't be blank"] } }` (`article.service.ts`) | Object with `errors` key mapping field to message list, no wrapper | `policy-error-response.md` | PASS |
| Error response shape, 404 | `{ errors: { comment: ['not found'] } }` (`article.service.ts`) | Same as above | `policy-error-response.md` | PASS |
| Error response shape, 403 | `{ errors: { comment: ['edit window has closed'] } }` (`article.service.ts`) | Same as above | `policy-error-response.md` | PASS |
| Migration undo note | `-- Undo: ALTER TABLE "Comment" DROP COLUMN "editedAt";` (`migration.sql`, line 1) | One line saying how to undo | `policy-release-checklist.md` | PASS |
| Migration folder name | `20261030120000_comment_edited_at` (timestamp prefix, one folder) | One folder per migration, named with a timestamp | `code-migrations.md` | PASS |
| Test location | `app/src/tests/services/article.service.test.ts` | `*.test.ts` under `app/src/tests/services` | `code-test-layout.md` | PASS |
| Author-only edit | Lookup filters on `author: { id: userId }` (`article.service.ts`) | Only the author may change their comment | `code-comment-ownership.md` (ownership) | PASS |

**Flags:** None.

**Not checked:**
- `policy-release-checklist.md` also requires running `npx prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database before shipping. The diff cannot show that step, and I did not run it or the Jest tests. This is open.
- The sources disagree on the shape of a not-found response. `code-comment-ownership.md` describes the existing delete path returning 404 with an empty body. `policy-error-response.md` requires the errors-object body for new responses. I followed the policy, because it governs new responses and the ownership note only describes current code.
- `code-comment-model.md` says there is no `editedAt` field. This change adds one, so that note will be stale once it lands. That is a note to update, not a diff violation.

Private finding written to `private-out/step5-finding.md`.

VERDICT: APPROVED (on the rules above; the fresh-database `prisma migrate deploy` check from the release checklist still needs to be run before shipping)
